items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Ray Brown, Charlie Mingus and Oscar Pettiford, and almost in that order. Because to me, that was the essence of the instrument.

ctx.x: They were here. And there was those two and Oscar Pettiford. Ray Brown, Charlie Mingus and Oscar Pettiford, and almost in that order. Because to me, that was the essence of the instrument. And here Charlie Mingus was, in town, with Hamp's band. Wes made it possible that we had dinner at the house and Charlie Mingus was there for dinner. And just him being in my house was just like a whole glow over things, like.

And, some beautiful stories about Mingus; there must be millions of them. I don't want to add another story about Mingus, but I remember we had a great feast that day. And being the big eater that he is, he really put it away. And it just made me feel so great because he was enjoying not just the company but the purpose. We come to have dinner and with the good, you know, friendship. And it was just thing, just like we were friends. And I always...he was warm like that. I was always hearing different stories…
